2607.28069.title: SemPIC: Learning Semantic Position-Independent KV Caches
2607.28069.paper_summary: Long-context retrieval and agentic workloads repeatedly reuse the same documents under changing instructions, histories, and document orders. Prefix caching cannot exploit this reuse, while position-independent caching (PIC) remains unreliable because independently compiled KV states lack the future context in which they will be consumed. Our diagnostics show that a learned boundary-conditioned baseline sharply reduces attention deviation near reusable-block boundaries but leaves interior and task-level residuals, motivating adaptation of the document representation itself. We present \emph{SemPIC}, which trains a LoRA-enabled Writer to compile native per-layer document KVs through behavioral distillation while retaining the pretrained decoder as an unchanged Reader. Adaptation is confined to offline cache construction, preserving the standard KV interface and cache-hit decoding path. We further introduce KV Gradient Checkpointing, which reduces peak training memory without severing gradients through cached KVs. Across three models and four tasks, SemPIC raises mean micro-F1 over KV Packet from 0.53 to 0.60, approaching Full Recompute at 0.62.
2607.28069.paper_summary_zh: 長期上下文檢索和代理工作負載在變化的指令、歷史和文件順序下重複使用相同的文件。前綴緩存無法利用這種重用，而位置無關緩存（PIC）仍然不可靠，因為獨立編譯的KV狀態缺乏將被消耗的未來上下文。我們的診斷顯示，學習的邊界條件基線在可重用區塊邊界附近顯著減少了注意力偏差，但在內部和任務級別留下了殘餘，這促使我們對文檔表示本身進行調整。我們提出了\emph{SemPIC}，它訓練一個啟用LoRA的Writer通過行為蒸餾編譯原生的每層文檔KV，同時保持預訓練的解碼器作為不變的Reader。調整僅限於離線緩存構建，保留標準的KV接口和緩存命中解碼路徑。我們進一步介紹了KV梯度檢查點，這在不切斷通過緩存KV的梯度的情況下減少了峰值訓練內存。在三個模型和四個任務中，SemPIC將KV Packet的平均微F1從0.53提高到0.60，接近全重新計算的0.62。
